title: Battle of Waterloo
description:
The **Battle of Waterloo** on June 18, 1815, marked Napoleon Bonaparte's final defeat. The Duke of Wellington and Prussian forces under Blücher defeated the French army.

This battle ended the Napoleonic Wars and Napoleon's rule as Emperor of France. He was exiled to Saint Helena where he died in 1821.

The battle ushered in nearly a century of relative peace in Europe.
